og.title: Donning and Doffing PPE | CARSI
og.description: Correct procedures for putting on and taking off personal protective equipment in contaminated environments. Covers sequences, technique, the transition zone, PPE disposal, and recognising heat exhaustion and heat stroke in workers wearing PPE.

faq.q: Why does this course focus so heavily on doffing?
faq.a: Because doffing is where most self-contamination events occur. A worker who has used PPE effectively throughout a job can undo that protection completely through incorrect removal, so the course teaches the sequence, the technique and the reasoning behind each step.

The purpose and types of PPE used in restoration and cleaning work, correct donning and doffing sequences and techniques for different PPE combinations, managing the transition zone, PPE disposal, and recognising and responding to heat exhaustion and heat stroke in workers wearing PPE.

faq.q: Does the course cover heat stress while wearing PPE?
faq.a: Yes. Recognising and responding to heat exhaustion and heat stroke in workers wearing PPE is one of the topics covered, alongside the donning and doffing sequences themselves.
